description: This Java class 'RatingStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze ratings of books in a reading shelf, including finding the most liked, least liked, and average ratings of books that have been read.

classes.name: RatingStatistics
classes.description: A class that provides statistical analysis of book ratings, including methods to find the most liked, least liked, and average ratings of books in the 'read' shelf.

methods.name: RatingStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the statistics object and loads the list of read books with ratings.

methods.name: findMostLikedBook
methods.description: Returns the read book with the highest rating, or an empty optional if none or only one rated book exists.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBook
methods.description: Returns the read book with the lowest rating, or an empty optional if none or only one rated book exists.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGiven
methods.description: Calculates the average rating of all rated read books, or returns empty if there are none.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Sums up the ratings of all read books that have a rating.
